questions.question: The Add-On Builder creates Splunk Apps that start with what?
Which of the following are data models used by ES? (Choose all that apply.)
After data is ingested, which data management step is essential to ensure raw data can be accelerated by a Data Model and used by ES?
answers: Normalization to the Splunk Common Information Model.
questions.correct_answer: Normalization to the Splunk Common Information Model.
